title: In-Place Home Resale Inspection Reports: Repair-Report Addition Schedule
content:
**Schedule note to the inspection report.** On an In-Place Home Resale package whose inspection fee is above 0.00, the initial inspection charge carries a repair-report addition, one of the inspection additions billed with that charge. The repair-report addition follows the count of standards items the initial inspection found failing, each written up in its repair report: 6 or more failing items add 30.00, at least 3 but fewer than 6 failing items add 15.00, and fewer failing items add nothing.

The count is the number of standards items failed as recorded on the file's initial inspection; an inspection recorded as passed has a count of 0. Re-inspections do not enter the count.

| Standards items failing at the initial inspection | Repair-report addition |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 | 0.00 |
| 2 | 0.00 |
| 3 | 15.00 |
| 4 | 15.00 |
| 5 | 15.00 |
| 6 | 30.00 |
| 7 to 10 | 30.00 |

**Reading the schedule.** An initial inspection that wrote up the roof, the skirting and the address numbers (3 items) carries 15.00; one that wrote up 2 items carries nothing, even if a later re-inspection found more (hypothetical reports).
